description: Sixteen value shift register: every clock moves the stored voltages along by one and reads a new one in

params.text: Picks which of the sixteen stored values the single output carries, 1 for the most recent

inputs.text: Each rising edge shifts the stored voltages along by one place and takes the input voltage into the first place
A rising edge clears the register, then fills it from the Seed input if one is patched or takes in the input voltage if not
The voltage that is read into the register on each clock
Fills the whole register on a reset, one channel per stored value

outputs.text: All sixteen stored values at once, one per channel, the most recent on the first channel
The stored value at the position set by the Pos knob

inputs.0: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.1: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
